summary: This document adds an NNTP extension for authentication, letting a client pick a method, run an authentication exchange and optionally set up a security layer. It formalizes AUTHINFO USER/PASS from RFC 2980, deprecates two older methods, and defines a SASL profile for NNTP.

eli5.summary: To read a private newsgroup you must show who you are. This sets the rules for the news server asking for a name and password, or other proof, in a standard way.
